text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Adhesive Capsulitis (Frozen Shoulder). The normal inflammatory markers and X-rays, combined with your 2-month history of insidious pain, sleep disruption, and significant limitation in both active and passive range of motion, rule out infection, fracture, or severe osteoarthritis. I recommend initiating a focused physical exam to confirm the global restriction of movement.
